I want to enquire whether it is true that masturbation is prohibited in islam? If not what is the correct way of doing it? (2) Next thing, I want to ask is by what quantity of siemen reduction it becomes essential for someone to take bath? Answer ID: 213 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 338=344/B (1) Yes, masturbation is forbidden in Islam. (2) If even a drop of semen comes out with shahwah (lust) then the bath will be farz (compulsory).
